messages:
Noah: quick postmortem follow-up for the OOMs on inference workers. recurring pattern: slow per-shard RSS growth + fragmentation after ~48h. need owners + short timelines.

Noah: proposed items (react or claim):
  1) lightweight continuous heap sampling + jemalloc stats (owner? ETA 48-72h)
  2) short-term per-shard soft cap + background eviction (owner? ETA 5d)
  3) fragmentation analysis and malloc_conf pilot (owner? ETA 10d)
  4) memory-drift dashboard + sustained-growth alert (owner? ETA 3d)
  5) runbook + repro steps (owner? ETA 4d)

Zara: I'll own 1) and 4). will start pprof snapshots every 5m on canaries and wire a Grafana panel for median/p90 shard RSS.

Ming: I'll take 2) and 3). plan: background LRU eviction when shard > working_set * 1.2 for >15m; eviction is non-blocking. will prototype malloc_conf on a gated canary.

Noah: Zara paste minimal capture steps so infra can schedule the job. include jemalloc stats collection.

Zara: gist (full script in ticket):
```
PODS=$(kubectl get pods -l app=infer -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}')
for p in $PODS; do
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "pprof -raw /proc/self/exe /tmp/heap.$(date +%s).pprof" || true
  kubectl exec $p -- sh -c "curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep jemalloc" > /tmp/jemalloc.$p.$(date +%s).txt || true
done
```
I'll link job once infra-bot creates it.

oncall-bot: job JOB-3301 scheduled to collect heap samples; next run in 4m.

Ming: eviction will add metrics: evictions_count and eviction_latency_ms. will ensure requests never block and add a canary rollout.

Noah: good. if jemalloc stats show high arena fragmentation, proceed with malloc_conf pilot only in dedicated pools and behind a feature flag.

infra-bot: created ticket INF-3301 "kv-cache memory drift follow-up" and linked incident. assignees: Zara, Ming, Noah.

Zara: initial pprof upload to INF-3301 incoming. early look shows a few shards with steady +25MB/day growth.

Noah: schedule a 30m sync in 3 days to review profiles, canary plan, and dashboard thresholds. please update INF-3301 with PRs and telemetry. :white_check_mark:
